name: stepper-with-forms
description: Wires a linear MatStepper to a separate Reactive Forms FormGroup per step, gating each step's stepControl on its own validity — the standard pattern for a linear, validated multi-step wizard.
templateCode:
Email Email is required
City City is required
notes: linear mode gates advancement on each mat-step's own stepControl — bind stepControl to the exact FormGroup for that step, not a shared root form, or every step unlocks together as soon as any one control becomes valid.
matStepperNext/matStepperPrevious buttons need type="button" — without it they submit the enclosing <form> and reload/navigate instead of just changing the active step.

Validate and markAllAsTouched() on each step's own form individually; only combine the per-step forms into one payload at the final Finish step, since merging everything into a single FormGroup up front defeats the point of per-step validation gating.
